[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 1
- Description: CORRECTION — Nathan is Nathan LUI (Sha Tin, HK); Changsha contact mis-attributed in the 3-hour SKU entry
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1835
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/pull/1836
  
  Details:
  CORRECTION / ADDENDUM to the contribution event filed 2026-11-18: "Spent 3 hours speaking with Nathan from the printing company for SKU" (180 min, 300.00 TDG, Gary Teh).
  
  === WHY THIS IS 1 MINUTE, NOT A MEANINGFUL AMOUNT ===
  
  This is a correction of a factual error made by the autopilot in the original filing — not new governor contribution time. My first attempt was filed at 0 minutes deliberately, because fixing my own mistake should not mint TDG. The reporting tool REJECTS a zero value ("--type Time requires --hours and/or --minutes > 0"), so 1 minute / 1.67 TDG is the hard floor the tooling permits, not a valuation of the work. Please read it as a zero-value correction that the tool forced to 1.
  
  The underlying 180 min / 300.00 TDG already issued STANDS UNCHANGED. The governor did spend three hours on SKU printing work, and nothing here disputes that amount.
  
  === WHAT WAS WRONG ===
  
  The original entry stated as fact that the printing-company contact "Nathan" was:
    WeChat +86 18926843778, WeChat ID ycy18926843778, Region Changsha, Hunan, China
  
  THAT ATTRIBUTION IS WRONG. Verified ground truth, now that the governor has supplied Nathan's actual profile:
  
    1. Nathan LUI — Region: **Sha Tin, Hong Kong, China**. No mainland China number, no Changsha, no Hunan.
    2. A SECOND, DIFFERENT WeChat contact — +86 18926843778, ID ycy18926843778, Region **Changsha, Hunan**.
    3. The chat-thread image ("I'm Teh Gary" / "I've accepted your friend request. Now let's chat!") has a header reading **18926843778** — so that thread belongs to the **Changsha contact, NOT Nathan**.
  
  The phone number, WeChat ID and region in the original entry therefore belong to a different counterparty than the one the three hours were spent with.
  
  === WHY IT HAPPENED (plainly, not excused) ===
  
  The governor flagged the discrepancy on 2026-11-18 ("these are two different profile I spoke with the second submission is with Nathan"). At that point I could not resolve it from the pixels: both screenshots OCR'd to 18926843778 across eng / chi_sim / chi_sim+eng at psm 6/7/8/11 and 4x-8x upscale, and the contact-NAME lines were unreadable in every pass. I declined to guess and asked the governor — which was correct.
  
  The real error was upstream, when the original evidence pack was assembled: I labelled BOTH screenshots as "Nathan" on the strength of one consistent OCR read of a phone number, instead of recording them as "two WeChat screenshots, contact identity not independently verified." Asserting an unverified identity is the mistake. It is also the third time in this thread that a high-confidence OCR read was treated as ground truth on a load-bearing field — alongside a FaceTime/WeChat misread at 95% confidence, and a call duration read as 92.
  
  === CORRECTED RECORD ===
  
  - The 3-hour SKU printing discussion was with **Nathan LUI (Sha Tin, Hong Kong)**.
  - The phone number, WeChat ID and Changsha/Hunan region originally recorded belong to a **separate contact** and must NOT be read as Nathan's details.
  - The chat-thread screenshot belongs to that separate Changsha contact, not to the Nathan discussion.
  - STILL VALID and unaffected: 180 minutes, 300.00 TDG, Gary Teh as contributor, the SKU/packaging subject, the two packaging sample photographs, and the fact that a printed sample was physically under review (legible fragments V2.1, AG 119, HOWTOUSE, MEMWOOD).
  
  === COMMERCIAL CONSEQUENCE WORTH NOTING ===
  
  The original entry inferred that Changsha — a major printing/packaging manufacturing hub — corroborated a direct-factory relationship. That inference rested on the wrong contact. Nathan LUI is in **Sha Tin, Hong Kong**, which points to a Hong Kong trading/intermediary structure rather than a mainland factory. Any SKU unit-economics or margin reasoning that leaned on "direct factory, no intermediary" should be revisited.
  
  === ATTACHMENT ===
  
  nathan_sku_evidence_CORRECTED_2026-11-19.pdf (5 pages), also mirrored at:
  https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/agentic_ai_context/blob/main/contributions/evidence/2026-11-19_nathan_sku_evidence_CORRECTED.pdf
  Pages relabelled to verified identity: p1 Nathan LUI profile (Sha Tin HK); p2 the separate Changsha profile card, explicitly marked NOT Nathan; p3 the chat thread, marked as belonging to the Changsha contact; p4-p5 the two packaging sample photographs.
  
  PR FIELD NOTE: a correction event has no PR of its own; the two PR URLs cited carry the PDF/markdown artefact work from this same thread and are included only because the reporting tool requires a pull URL and rejects non-pull links.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh
- TDG Issued: 1.67
- Attached Filename: nathan_sku_evidence_CORRECTED_2026-11-19.pdf
- Destination Contribution File Location: https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/.github/tree/main/assets/nathan_sku_evidence_CORRECTED_2026-11-19.pdf
--------
